description: Starts the x402 facilitator double on 127.0.0.1 and returns its URL. Start YOUR resource server with this URL as its facilitator (for example X402_FACILITATOR_URL) and offering Solana devnet or Base Sepolia, then call x402_probe_resource_server. The double never touches a chain, key or network beyond loopback.

port.description: Loopback port; 0 or omitted picks a free one

name: x402_start_facilitator_double
title: Start the facilitator double
